scenario: Output definition per [LDET.2.1]'s output column (LDET.10.6, the id, is a tombstone) — every observable event: activations, firings, emissions, retractions, calls, cache ops, logs, logical lifecycle. Pin: a rule's firing, its emission and its log are each an event on the stream, in source order: the host's fact_assert, then rule_fire_begin, the emitted Out's fact_assert, the emit's action_emit, the log's action_log, and rule_fire_end. A runtime that left any of the three out of the output fails it.
rules_ds:
schema Trig scope logical:
    v: Int key

schema Out scope ttl 1_h:
    v: Int

rule r:
    Trig t
->
    emit Out v: t.v
    log info "out {t.v}"
